scope: Every roster endpoint in the official athletics sports navigation, plus the men’s basketball endpoint. Combined pages retain their complete published mixed-gender roster.
programCountNote: 36 varsity programs: the source facts page identifies the 2025–26 total; the current athletics navigation retains all 36. Cross country, fencing, sailing, and track & field each publish one combined roster page.
identityPolicy: Deduplicate by official stable player ID; never merge people solely because names match.
competitionNote: Stanford is an NCAA Division I institution. Artistic swimming, sailing, squash, men’s rowing and lightweight rowing are included as Stanford varsity teams but compete under their own collegiate governing bodies, not an NCAA championship in those disciplines.
venueNote: Venue association indicates a documented Stanford team facility or athletics district, not where an individual is physically present. Cross-country athletes use the track district for the virtual visit; this does not relocate cross-country courses. Indoor programs can compete at more than one venue. Rowing and sailing remain at the actual off-campus center.
availabilityNote: All imported names are available in the virtual character registry. Rendering uses proximity and crowd limits; no claim of simultaneous attendance is made.
